title: Variance Reduction & CUPED
interviewAnswer: CUPED uses pre-experiment covariates correlated with the outcome to reduce variance without changing the treatment effect expectation under valid conditions, increasing experiment sensitivity.
why: Variance Reduction & CUPED appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.
deepDive: CUPED uses pre-experiment covariates correlated with the outcome to reduce variance without changing the treatment effect expectation under valid conditions, increasing experiment sensitivity. Correlation with outcome determines gain. Avoid leakage from treatment-period features. A strong practitioner separates the modeling assumption from the estimation procedure, checks diagnostics rather than trusting a single score, and explains what would make the method inappropriate.
workedExample: Adjust spend outcome using pre-experiment spend to detect smaller treatment lifts.
commonMistakes: Applying the method without checking its assumptions or data-generating process.
Choosing it because it is familiar rather than comparing against an appropriate baseline.

production: In production, validate assumptions on real data, monitor the quantities that can drift, and keep a simple baseline so added complexity has a measurable reason to exist.
